import_provenance.original_title: A Greibach normal form for conjunctive grammars
import_provenance.original_statement: Can every conjunctive language not containing the empty word be generated with rules A→aβ₁ & ⋯ & aβₖ, where each βᵢ is a string of nonterminals? Such a normal form would ensure that each recursive expansion consumes an input symbol, generalizing a fundamental theorem for context-free grammars.
